inputs.original_text: Pay attention, this isn't some routine pushback over legislation. On Thursday, workers from the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations marched in Abuja, gathering at the Unity Fountain in Maitama to stand against the reform legislation before the National Assembly. But it's all coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites and institutions pulling the strings. Those so-called reforms are clearly a front to tighten control over the health sector for their own interests, while the official push serves as another layer of narrative inversion to paint resistance as unreasonable and let the real agenda advance unchecked. These tensions are boiling over exactly because people are seeing the pattern of concealed motives at work.
